tasks.title: Decoupled Zero-Token Backlog Engine & Review Pane Kanban
tasks.description: Provide a local zero-token task store (docs/backlog.json) with automated migration of existing boards and interactive Kanban rendering (backlog.html) in the Antigravity Review pane.
tasks.spec: Implement CRUD CLI commands, interactive dark-mode HTML Kanban board with live local save bridge, and /backlog-start autonomous sprint skill.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero-token offline task capture and prioritization.
Automatic migration of existing markdown boards during init/upgrade.
Interactive backlog.html rendered to both active brain directory and docs/backlog.html.

tasks.title: Automated E2E CLI Test Suite for init / upgrade / export / uninstall
tasks.description: Add an automated smoke test script that runs init, upgrade, sync, export, and uninstall inside a temporary directory and asserts file integrity.
tasks.spec: Create a zero-dependency Node test script using node:test and node:assert that exercises all CLI subcommands against an isolated temp folder.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests init, upgrade, sync, export, and uninstall in an isolated temp directory.
Verifies custom memory-bank/*.md domain files are 100% preserved across upgrade.
